text_description: A full-length runway look centered on a close-cut black long-sleeve dress with a high turtleneck collar and a smooth, body-skimming column silhouette. The dress is fitted through the shoulders, torso, hips, and thighs, with narrow sleeves extending to the wrists and a hem falling just below the knee; subtle horizontal bunching and soft folds gather around the lower hip, thigh, and knee area, giving the otherwise sleek shape a slightly ruched, pulled-in finish. A large exposed side cutout is visible along the model’s raised-arm side, opening from beneath the arm down toward the waist/high hip and revealing bare skin while the front remains covered and minimal. Styling is dark and polished: a glossy deep oxblood-brown structured handbag hangs from the raised wrist/forearm on a slim strap, accented by small metallic hardware, and a narrow dark cuff or bracelet with metallic detailing sits at the same wrist. The shoes are black pointed-toe high heels with a shiny finish and small reflective or embellished highlights at the toe area. The overall mood is severe, sleek, and evening-leaning, reinforced by the monochrome black dress, sharp bob haircut with blunt bangs, and precise, elongated runway posture.
key_elements: visible side cutout from underarm toward waist/high hip
below-knee bodycon hem with subtle ruching
dark wrist cuff with metallic detail
uncertainty_notes: Dress surface appears smooth and possibly knit or jersey, but material is not definitively visible.
Shoe toe area appears glossy and lightly reflective or embellished.
